band_contract.easy: Authored canonical e-5014 matching-differential cases: integer factor supplied in numerator, absolute value, and radical.
band_contract.moderate: Observed visible |sx| and (sx)^2 with a surviving integer or fractional reciprocal factor; no normalization of |x| required.
band_contract.hard: Observed |x| normalization: explicitly use |u|=s|x| with positive s; integer, radical, and denominator-prefactor cases. No new branch or integration method.

sampling: Structural case first; independent positive exact coefficient roles. No global source-number substitution. Mathematical task deduplication across a batch.
limits: Finite bounded catalogs; count 1..100 is an input limit, not a guarantee of that many distinct tasks. Explicit exhaustion. Secant easy has a small integer matching-differential catalog.
